title: P18.6 — Semantic-First Goal Understanding + closures: guarded evidence binding, strict snapshot scope, IDENTITY-binding approval (structured issue keys, accept-vs-supplied decisions, endpoint ownership+lifecycle authority)
description: P18.6 IDENTITY closure on base cabd25d - hardens F2 approval-resolution binding. >=60% token-overlap coverage accepted entity/channel/quantity/project swaps as 'reviewed'. Now approvals bind structured ISSUE IDENTITIES: issueKeyFor = category + exact discriminating-token set (generic issue-shape words filtered EN+VI); every material-driving UNRESOLVED item in the confirmed revision's pinned analysis needs coverage by an approved issue with identical category + issue_key. Owner decisions distinguished: resolutions[] records accepted_assumption vs supplied_value (bounded text; decisions fold into revision_digest). Endpoint authority: READY lifecycle + authenticated operator + preview operator ownership enforced (FAIL_CLOSED_*). verifyGoalIntentApproval re-derives item_statements + approved_issues from the pinned analysis and validates resolutions[] (tamper fails closed). Audit R3 folds: dedicated issue tokenizer (len>=2 + single-char numerics - v2/us/50/ii swaps discriminated); wh-dimension words (when/where/who + VN equivalents) stay discriminating; empty discriminating sets fall back to normalized statement (content-free statements never cross-cover); READY is a mint precondition AFTER idempotent lookup (retry returns the minted row; new mint on consumed preview fails closed). Genuine approve->amend->re-preview->confirm preserved; adversarial probes cover swaps over HTTP + real confirm seam. Prior closures (guarded evidence binding, strict snapshot scope) unchanged. Baseline: interpretation ADVISORY only; OFF default; no auto-merge.
